result.summary: The page appears visually intact. The layout, images, badges, and navigation render cleanly with no overlapping, misaligned, or missing elements. The only notable finding is a minor contrast concern with some light gray secondary text. The clipped chip row, partially visible carousel card, and cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended scroll and viewport behavior.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the delivery fees (e.g., '€0.90 delivery'), the rating count '(500+)', and the meta line '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' is light gray on a white background, which may fall below recommended WCAG contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against white.
